description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of two language models, Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, across six different question answering datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets – TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1) – listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” displays a linear scale ranging from 25 to 85, with tick labels at 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, 75, and 85. For each dataset, there are two bars representing the model scores: a blue bar for Flan-T5-783M and an orange bar for GPT-4. The bar for Flan-T5-783M reaches approximately 77.3 for TriviaQA (EM), 44.5 for HotPotQA (EM), 32.5 for 2Wiki (EM), 82.8 for TriviaQA (F1), 43.3 for HotPotQA (F1), and 38.1 for 2Wiki (F1). The bar for GPT-4 reaches approximately 77.1 for TriviaQA (EM), 37.0 for HotPotQA (EM), 31.9 for 2Wiki (EM), 83.8 for TriviaQA (F1), 49.7 for HotPotQA (F1), and 53.3 for 2Wiki (F1). The bars are arranged in pairs for each dataset, with Flan-T5-783M consistently positioned to the left of GPT-4. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
